description: The reports this account sent with feedback_send (from any of its keys), newest first, each with its status (received, triaged, fixed, wont_fix, needs_info), the team's response and responded_at. Free. Use it to check whether a reported bug was fixed before reporting it again. Page with `cursor` from the previous `next_cursor`.

cursor.description: The previous page's next_cursor, passed back unchanged.
